import { LitElement, html, css } from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/lit';

class DmoProductCard extends LitElement {
  static properties = {
    titleText: { type: String },
    bodyText: { type: String },
    priceText: { type: String },
    buttonText: { type: String }
  };

  static styles = css`
    :host {
      display: block;
    }
  `;

  render() {
    return html`
      <dmo-container 
        _backgroundColor="wc_background_default"
        _borderColor="wc_border_danger"
        _borderWidth="wc_border_width_lg"
        _borderStyle="solid"
        _cornerRadius="wc_border_radius_md"
        _padding="wc_padding_2x"
        _gap="wc_gap_2x"
        _layoutDirection="column"
        _alignItems="start"
        _justifyContent="start"
        _horizontalResizing="fixed"
        _width="400px"
        _verticalResizing="hug"
        _height="200px"
        internalLabel="product-card">
        <dmo-text 
          _textColor="wc_text_default"
          _horizontalResizing="fill"
          _width="368px"
          _verticalResizing="hug"
          _height="37px"
          type="heading-md"
          text="${this.titleText}">
        </dmo-text>
        <dmo-text 
          _textColor="wc_text_default"
          _horizontalResizing="fill"
          _width="368px"
          _verticalResizing="hug"
          _height="54px"
          type="body-sm"
          text="${this.bodyText}">
        </dmo-text>
        <dmo-container 
          _gap="wc_gap_2x"
          _layoutDirection="row"
          _alignItems="start"
          _justifyContent="space-between"
          _horizontalResizing="fill"
          _width="368px"
          _verticalResizing="hug"
          _height="45px"
          internalLabel="price-button-container">
          <dmo-text 
            _textColor="wc_text_default"
            _horizontalResizing="hug"
            _width="127px"
            _verticalResizing="hug"
            _height="45px"
            type="heading-lg"
            text="${this.priceText}">
          </dmo-text>
          <dmo-button 
            emphasis="bold"
            design="primary"
            label="${this.buttonText}"
            target=""
            url="#">
          </dmo-button>
        </dmo-container>
      </dmo-container>
    `;
  }
}

customElements.define('dmo-product-card', DmoProductCard);

<dmo-product-card 
    titleText="Example Product"
    bodyText="This is a great product."
    priceText="$19.99"
    buttonText="Buy Now">
</dmo-product-card>
